description: Use this when you need to know the account's plan, how much of its monthly quota is used, or why a send or inbox create returned 402. Read-only; requires auth; no inputs. Returns {plan, plan_name, status, usage:{period, sends, inboxes}, limits:{inboxes, emails_per_month, custom_domains}, addons:{available, path, inboxes, domains, email_packs}, upgrade:{next_plan, upgrade_url}, …}. addons.available is true on Starter and Pro. Buy or change those quantities with cooper_set_addons.
name: cooper_billing_status
title: Billing status
